chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Sulaymān al-Ḥammār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
It is not appropriate for a Muslim man among you to marry a Nāṣibī woman, nor to give his daughter in marriage to a Nāṣibī man, nor to leave her with him.

key_terms.ابْنَتَهُ: his daughter, in the context of guardianship in marriage
key_terms.النَّاصِبِيَّةَ: a female Nāṣibī, one hostile to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِ: the Muslim believer addressed by the ruling
key_terms.نَاصِبًا: a male Nāṣibī proposed as a husband
key_terms.يَتَزَوَّجَ: to marry or enter into marriage
key_terms.يَطْرَحَهَا: to leave or place her in his custody or care

ai.seo_question: Can a Muslim marry a Nāṣibī or give his daughter in marriage to one according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal and social prohibition concerning marriage ties with a Nāṣibī. It forbids a Muslim man from marrying a Nāṣibī woman, from marrying his daughter to a Nāṣibī man, and from placing her under his care.
